tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All Terms and condition as per tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Name and Address of the Tenderer: The complete name and address of the tendering firm/company shall be furnished.
Earnest Money Deposit (EMD): Details and proof of payment of the prescribed security deposit amount shall be submitted.
Experience Certificate: The tenderer must have a minimum of 05 years of experience in the supply and installation of CCTV cameras. Relevant supporting documents shall be submitted.

Satisfactory Service Certificate: The tenderer shall submit satisfactory service certificates issued by Government / Semi-Government departments or other competent authorities for the installation of CCTV cameras.
Import and Export Certificate: The tenderer shall mandatorily submit the Importer Exporter Code (IEC) Certificate.
Authorised Manufacturer / System Integrator Certificate: The tenderer shall mandatorily submit an Authorised Manufacturer or System Integrator (SI) Certificate.
Local Service Centre / Business Office: The tenderer shall furnish details of the local service centre or business office, along with supporting documents issued by the competent authority.
MSME Certificate: The tenderer shall submit the certificate issued by the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME) / Udyam Registration Certificate.

Affidavit: The tenderer shall submit an affidavit on Rs. 100/- e-Stamp Bond Paper declaring that the firm/company has not been blacklisted by any Government department or authority and that no court case is pending against the firm/company.
ISO 9001 Certificate: The tenderer shall mandatorily submit a valid ISO 9001 Certificate.
STQC Certificate: The tenderer shall submit the applicable STQC Certificate.
Police Verification Certificate: The tenderer shall submit a valid Police Verification Certificate.
Labour Department Registration Certificate: The tenderer shall submit the registration certificate issued by the Labour Department.

Escalation Matrix: The tenderer shall submit an escalation matrix containing the names, designations, contact numbers and email addresses of the concerned officials for service support during the warranty period.
GST Registration Certificate: Authorised dealers shall submit valid Goods and Services Tax (GST) registration certificates and documents containing their GST Identification Number (GSTIN).
Professional Tax Certificate: The tenderer shall submit a valid Professional Tax Registration Certificate.

Annual Turnover Certificate and Income Tax Returns: The tenderer shall submit annual turnover certificates and Income Tax Returns (ITR) for the last three financial years, namely 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26.
